summary: The team is in a critical push to launch the China Going-Global report and Intelligent China webpage while resolving an Outlook account lockout and advancing the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: The most urgent priority is the China Going-Global report and Singapore event: this week, finalize the one-page flyer, launch the report webpage, update the press release with the new title, and confirm guest approvals for Raven Ng and Yijia Wang. In parallel, the Intelligent China webpage must launch this week to start driving traffic, and the team needs to draft a plan for target areas and prompts, analyze participant profiles and CRM leads, and audit conversion tracking. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward with Joseph and Julie meeting to mark specific feedback, Joker making design changes, and decisions to remove the video section, integrate videos into topics, and bring BCI indices to the homepage. Additionally, the Outlook account lockout requires immediate action: all devices must delete the account and re-login with the new password, and JSB must confirm the backend lock is released. Looking ahead, a Chinese email update to Chen Zongchao on the Sep 15-16 Singapore activities is due by Sep 11, and the team must continue prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing.
